dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Did you know, yesterday I tried to mặc cả at Ben Thanh market and got laughed at by the seller. I only knew how to say "reduce it" and "too expensive."

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Really? I used to be like that too. In Russia, we don't mặc cả as much as in Vietnam. When I first came đây, I paid double the thực price for everything.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Mặc cả is an important skill đây. Do you know the word "discount"? I find it more effective than "reduce it."

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Discount? I'll try that. But more importantly is to biết the thực giá before you mặc cả. Mặc cả without knowing the real giá just makes you look silly... như you yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey! I didn't look silly... just a bit awkward. Next time, would you go to the market with me? I want to learn how to mặc cả from someone who has lived đây as long as you.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Me? Teach you how to mặc cả? Aren't you Vietnamese-American? But... fine, if you really need help. When do you want to go?
